description: A company's SEC filings, newest first, filtered by form type (10-K, 10-Q, 8-K, DEF 14A, S-1, 4, 13F-HR...) and dates, with links. Use read_filing to read one.

forms.description: Form types, for example ["10-K", "8-K"]; amendments (10-K/A) are included. Default: all.

since.description: Filed on or after this date.

until.description: Filed on or before this date.

name: list_filings

outputSchema.description: rows are filings, newest first, in the order of columns.
